scripts.build:assets: pnpm --filter @narada2/operator-console-ui build && pnpm --filter @narada2/agent-web-ui build && pnpm run build:scripts && node scripts-dist/build-cloudflare-assets.js
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:live: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:synthetic:dry-run: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.synthetic.toml
scripts.deploy:synthetic: pnpm run build:assets && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.synthetic.toml
scripts.smoke:local-origin-live: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:scripts && node scripts-dist/cloudflare-nars-web-projection-live-smoke.js
scripts.smoke:cloudflare-origin-live: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:scripts && node scripts-dist/cloudflare-nars-authority-live-smoke.js
scripts.smoke:provider-capable-live: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:scripts && node scripts-dist/cloudflare-nars-provider-capable-live-smoke.js
